subject: Request: Extended POC credits for VPC due to security review
messages:
From: Alex White <alex.white@kitehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteHealth Security Team <security@kitehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Requesting additional POC credits — VPC access blocked by security review

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product looked promising and the team is keen to move an internal POC forward. We're currently blocked by a last-mile security review: our SecOps team needs to run the model inside our VPC (private deployment) and they require a short trial of the same setup and logs to validate data flow and isolation.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide additional trial credits specifically for the Private/VPC POC (we estimate ~200k tokens over 30 days) so we can complete the technical validation in a realistic load window?
- Will you share a redacted sample of the audit logs or a short checklist showing what telemetry Redwood collects during a Private deployment? Our reviewers need this to close their risk assessment.

We're on a tight timeline: SecOps wants to complete validation by mid-April to make the Q2 rollout decision. If we can get credits and the security excerpt this week, we can push things forward quickly.

I've attached the security questionnaire we filled so you can see the exact gating items.

Appreciate your help — please let me know what you require from our side (e.g., a signed MAA or PO).

Best,
Alex White
Director of Engineering, KiteHealth
alex.white@kitehealth.com
(415) 555-0129

Attachments: kite_security_questionnaire_answers.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex White <alex.white@kitehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting additional POC credits — VPC access blocked by security review

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear note and the questionnaire — that's helpful. We want to support the VPC validation but need to align on a couple of controls before issuing a promo credit. Quick answers up front:

- We can provision a one-off credit top-up specifically scoped to the Private deployment (not applicable to hosted API) to cover the validation workload.
- Before we issue, we'll need a short acknowledgement of Redwood's standard trial credit T&Cs (I can paste those below) and confirmation that KiteHealth will sign a minimal Mutual Access Agreement (MAA) for the POC.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) We provide a 120k-token credit for a 30-day Private POC to start (can bump if SecOps proves more load).
2) Rishi will review the questionnaire and attach a short redacted telemetry checklist you can share with your SecOps.
3) Naomi (finance) will confirm the process for extending credits or converting to a paid pilot if you decide to continue.

Can you confirm:
- Is Kite able to sign a short MAA (DocuSign or PDF) that limits the POC to the VPC project and clarifies that Redwood's credits are promotional?
- Do you need the audit log sample in a particular format (CSV vs JSON) or is a high-level checklist sufficient for now?

I'll hold on issuing anything until Rishi OKs the security artifacts, but we can move quickly once you confirm the MAA route.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

[Redwood standard trial credit T&Cs]
- Credits are promotional and expire 30 days after issuance unless otherwise agreed.
- Credits are non-transferable and valid only for the listed account and deployment mode.
- Redemptions that result in abuse or violation of our Terms may be revoked.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Alex White <alex.white@kitehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting additional POC credits — VPC access blocked by security review

Looping in from Security. Alex — thanks for sending the questionnaire. I reviewed the answers and the items flagged by your team. Redwood can provide an expanded promo credit for this specific Private POC under these conditions: 

- Approval: Conditional credit of 150,000 tokens for 45 days (to give room for validation and any repeat runs).
- Documentation: We'll provide a redacted telemetry checklist + a sample (JSON) of the audit/events schema we collect for Private deployments.
- Agreement: KiteHealth must sign the Redwood POC MAA (I attached a one-page approval note that Naomi will co-sign for finance to track).
- Data handling: All logs we provide will be redacted for identifiers; full raw logs require an executed data-sharing addendum.

I've attached the internal approval stub (credit-approval-note.pdf) that says Security authorizes the promo credit subject to the above. Naomi — please update billing to reflect the promo ledger entry once signed MAA is returned.

If that sounds acceptable, Hannah — please provision the credit and send the telemetry checklist (I've prepared the snippet to avoid exposing internal metadata).

-Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: credit-approval-note.pdf
From: Alex White <alex.white@kitehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, KiteHealth Security Team <security@kitehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Requesting additional POC credits — VPC access blocked by security review

Hannah / Rishi / Naomi —

Thank you all — that plan works for us. We can sign the POC MAA; I'll get the DocuSign routed today and attach the signed copy here. Appreciate the 150k-token, 45-day credit — that should be sufficient for our validation window.

A couple quick notes:
- Our SecOps prefers the sample telemetry in JSON; if you can provide the sample and checklist, we'll give them the files tomorrow.
- We'll return the signed MAA by end of day Monday.

I've attached the completed questionnaire we sent earlier (for reference) and will upload the signed MAA to the DocuSign link once it's complete. Next step: can we schedule a 30-minute handoff with your security engineer next Tuesday to walk through the telemetry and VPC connectivity map?

Best,
Alex

Attachments: kite_security_questionnaire_answers.pdf, kite_signed_maa.pdf
